author: Teresa Elena Frontado
description:
Chinese first lady Peng Liyuan shared a light moment with Melania Trump on Wednesday as the two women renewed an acquaintance dating back to the Trumps’ first term in the White House.
The first ladies smiled as they greeted each other at the foot of the aircraft stairs at Joint Base Andrews, where Peng arrived with President Xi Jinping for a visit to Washington. Walking behind their husbands along the red carpet, Peng gestured towards the honour guard, apparently remarking on the soldiers’...
title: Peng Liyuan and Melania Trump renew acquaintance as Xi arrives in US

author: Vincent Chow
description:
There are growing calls for Washington and Beijing to agree to slow down development of artificial intelligence. But even if they wanted to do so, how could they verify that the other side would do the same?
A group of researchers and start-ups is developing technology intended to make this a possibility, without relying on trust alone. Their proposed tools would allow third parties and governments to check some claims about how AI models are being trained or used – possibly without needing...
title: Can the US and China verify an AI deal? Start-ups are starting to build the tools

author: Lucy Quaggin
description:
Hours before Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the US for a high-stakes summit, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio moved to restrict visas for those who “engage in or facilitate” birth tourism, a practice the Trump administration has increasingly accused China of.
“By restricting visa issuance of those who both engage in and profit from this fraud, we are sending a clear message: the United States will not allow foreigners to exploit our immigration system and violate the sanctity of US...
title: US restricts visas for birth tourism ahead of Xi Jinping’s summit with Trump

author: Mark Magnier
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping landed at Joint Base Andrews late Wednesday afternoon after a 15-hour flight where he was greeted on the tarmac by US President Donald Trump in an unprecedented move for a top American leader.
The closely watched visit – Xi’s first summit in the United States in 11 years – comes as the two nations grapple with a host of thorny issues beneath the flowery language and statements of friendship, including artificial intelligence, critical minerals, tariffs, Ukraine, the...
title: Xi lands in US for high-stakes summit with Trump amid deep tensions

author: Ravi Kant
description:
A country’s diaspora can be a symbol of its pride and power. A nation’s diaspora can help it build international value through success stories, promote its soft power through culture and contribute to its economic progress through remittances, investments and transfers of expertise.
India and China have among the world’s largest diasporas. They also offer two very different models of how countries can leverage their diasporas.
In India, before the 1991 reforms, people mostly saw those who left...
title: China is leveraging its diaspora to boost the economy, unlike India

description:

Unrivalled Xi-Trump summit analysis: get real-time updates and exclusive boots-on-the-ground reporting from our US and China bureaus. Subscribe now with great savings to stay ahead.
President Xi Jinping is meeting US President Donald Trump in Washington, in the first face-to-face talks between the Chinese and American leaders since Trump visited Beijing in May.


On this first day of Xi’s three-day...
title: Xi begins 3-day US visit with rare airport welcome from Trump

author: Mark Magnier
description:
US President Donald Trump has been very eager to show off to Chinese leader Xi Jinping his new US$5 million White House helipad, his latest bid to stamp his image on Washington.
While Xi might act impressed and compliment the US president on his latest building project – part of Trump’s bid to match Xi’s splendour-filled hosting four months ago in Beijing and show the Chinese that Americans can build infrastructure too – do not count on Xi actually trying it out with a chopper ride this week...
title: Donald Trump built a US$5 million White House helipad. Don’t expect Xi Jinping to use it

author: Lucy Quaggin
description:
A grand military welcome, a state dinner, tea at the White House and a tour of the National Archives: Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington will see his American counterpart, Donald Trump, roll out the pomp and pageantry.
The United States’ capital is bracing for high-level bilateral discussions served with a side of symbolic gestures, marking Xi’s first state visit to the country since 2015.
But what exactly makes this a state visit, and how does it differ from other official...
title: All you need to know about a state visit, as White House rolls out red carpet for Xi

author: Igor Patrick
description:
Paraguayan President Santiago Pena told the United Nations General Assembly on Wednesday that his country “is not neutral” on the Taiwan Strait, pledging support for the self-ruled island and calling for its “full and meaningful participation” in the UN system.
Casting a conflict in the strait as a potentially far greater threat than the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, Pena warned of “ominous clouds gathering over the Indo-Pacific” and of a conflict that would hit Japan, the rest of East and...
title: Paraguay’s president urges UN to let Taiwan in, calls island’s exclusion ‘a stain’

author: Han Li
description:
As Chinese President Xi Jinping makes his high-profile state visit to the US, Americans’ views of China remain negative but have improved in recent years, according to a new Pew Research Centre report.
Using a “feeling thermometer” ranging from zero, the coldest rating, to 100, the warmest, Pew found that Americans gave China an average rating of 37, up from 28 in 2021.
“The [Xi-Trump] meeting comes as Americans’ feelings about China have warmed in recent years, even though they remain cold...
title: American views of China improve before Xi-Trump summit, Pew report finds

author: Nayan Seth
description:
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held an unscheduled meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in Washington on Wednesday, hours before Chinese President Xi Jinping was due to arrive for a state visit.
“We had some unfinished business from Sunday. We want strategic stability, but it has to be based on reciprocity and fairness,” Bessent told Fox News on his way to the meeting.
The talks are under way at the World Bank headquarters in the US capital, following the two leaders’ engagement on...
title: Bessent and He meet again to tackle  ‘some unfinished business’ as Xi summit nears

author: Gabriel Dominguez
description:
The US Air Force is shutting down a major research centre dedicated to open-source analysis of the Chinese military’s air, space, cyber and missile capabilities.
The China Aerospace Studies Institute (CASI) said in a statement on Tuesday that Air University, the US Air Force institution under which it operates, had decided to close the institute, with all of its roles becoming unfunded from October 1.
CASI said its employees would continue to work and get paid for now and that it expected to...
title: US Air Force to shut down research centre focusing on Chinese military

author: Liu Zhen
description:
US President Donald Trump has made no secret of how little he agrees with his predecessor, Joe Biden, on many things.
So, as Chinese President Xi Jinping is about to arrive in Washington on Wednesday, local time, there is one object that may offer a small moment of entertaining comparison between the two American leaders: Xi’s car.
Xi is expected to bring his own ride – a custom-built Hongqi N701, the Chinese state limousine that has accompanied him on overseas trips since 2022.

In a brief...
title: Xi-Trump summit: China’s state car has already proved a match for the US ‘Beast’

author: Shi Huang
description:
Neurobiologist Ye Bing is returning to China after a long period in the United States, but he says his move is not linked to the suicide of another Chinese scholar at the same university or US policy under the Trump administration.
Ye said his decision to join Nanjing University and leave the University of Michigan was not influenced by the death of Chinese scholar Wang Danhao on the same campus six months earlier – a day after Wang was interviewed by US Homeland Security officers.
“This is a...
title: Neurobiologist Ye Bing says his return to China is not spurred by Michigan campus tragedy

author: Khushboo Razdan
description:
Hours before President Xi Jinping’s aircraft lands at Joint Base Andrews, Washington is preparing for a scene that seemed unthinkable in recent years: his American counterpart waiting on the tarmac for the leader of a country that much of the US national security establishment regards as its foremost strategic adversary.
While the Donald Trump administration is betting on warmth, deals and stability with Beijing, recent public surveys show that American anxiety over China has eased from its 2024...
title: China hawks grumble over Trump’s lavish welcome planned for Xi state visit

author: William Zheng
description:
China’s ambassador to the United States has hailed President Xi Jinping’s coming state visit as a “historic milestone” for bilateral and international relations.
Xie Feng’s remarks came just as Beijing unveiled stringent new regulations on fentanyl, in a clear move to build diplomatic momentum ahead of the Xi-Trump summit in Washington.
Under the strategic guidance of both leaders, the “giant ship” of China-US relations would continue to “break waves and sail ahead” along a trajectory of “mutual...
title: Ahead of Xi’s ‘historic milestone’ US visit, a fentanyl goodwill gesture from China

author: Albee Zhang
description:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk described Chinese President Xi Jinping as “a great leader” and “very capable” during an interview with China’s state broadcaster on Wednesday, just hours before Xi left China for a summit with US President Donald Trump.
“He seems like a great leader. Under his tenure, China has prospered immensely. I’ve seen it first hand,” Musk said in one of a series of videos posted on CCTV’s social media account.
“And it’s also obvious to see just walking around the streets, the …...
title: Tesla’s Elon Musk hails Xi Jinping’s leadership and Chinese AI strength

author: Brian Rhoads,Raymond Ma
description:
China will probably decide against inviting business leaders to join President Xi Jinping on his trip to the United States this week as the two countries struggle to reach investment agreements.
A lack of agreement about a planned bilateral Board of Investment and differences over potential Chinese investments in the US have put the business delegation in doubt, the South China Morning Post said, citing a person familiar with the situation. The Wall Street Journal reported the story earlier.
The...
title: China CEOs to likely miss Xi’s US trip amid thin summit expectations

author: Phoebe Zhang
description:
China’s industry minister is set to lead Anhui province, a key semiconductor hub, in the latest personnel reshuffle within the Communist Party.
Li Lecheng, 61, has served as minister of industry and information technology since April 2025.
State news agency Xinhua reported on Wednesday that Li had been appointed the party secretary of Anhui and a member of its standing committee, taking over both roles from Liang Yanshun.
Liang, Anhui party chief since June 2024, retains his role as party...
title: China puts industry minister in charge of key semiconductor hub Anhui province

author: Caroline Lin
description:
China’s first lady Peng Liyuan is again stepping into the international limelight as she travels to Washington with President Xi Jinping this week.
Xi and Peng were invited to visit the White House by Donald Trump in May, when the US leader was in Beijing.
They are expected to arrive at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday, local time, to begin their three-day visit. On Thursday, Xi and Peng will be welcomed at the White House with a State Floor arrival ceremony and a Rose Garden military...
title: China’s first lady Peng Liyuan projects glamour and soft power on world stage

author: Albee Zhang
description:
The expulsion of two former leaders from the Chinese armed forces and Communist Party “eliminated a major hidden political danger”, China’s military mouthpiece said on Wednesday.
The party expelled Zhang Youxia, former vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), and fellow former CMC member Liu Zhenli for factionalism and disloyalty, state media reported on Monday.
The CMC is the country’s top military authority and is chaired by President Xi Jinping.
“The serious investigation and...
title: PLA chiefs’ downfall eliminated ‘political danger’, military mouthpiece says

author: SCMP
description:
We have put together stories from our coverage on science from the past two weeks to help you stay informed. If you would like to see more of our reporting, please consider subscribing.
1. J-50 design team reveals leapfrog tech for China’s next-gen stealth fighters
China’s next-generation combat aircraft will be able to fly by themselves if a pilot loses consciousness, navigate without satellite signals and operate in self-reorganising large drone formations.
2. Chinese scientists develop oil...
title: China’s stealth fighters, critical minerals from lithium waste: 7 science highlights

author: Seong Hyeon Choi
description:
North Korea could be using missile tests to take its denuclearisation off the US-China summit agenda and drive home its demands for recognition as a nuclear power as a prerequisite for talks with Washington, according to analysts.
On Sunday, North Korea fired two short-range ballistic missiles towards the Sea of Japan, or East Sea, which, according to South Korea’s joint chiefs of staff, were detected three hours apart, with the first flying about 450km (280 miles), while the second travelled...
title: Did North Korea’s missile launches target the Xi-Trump summit agenda?

author: Meredith Chen
description:
With Chinese President Xi Jinping expected in Washington this week, attention is turning to the aircraft that will carry him and how it stacks up against America’s presidential plane.
The aircraft carrying China’s leader, often referred to in state media and official statements as a zhuan ji, or special plane, remains far less known to the world than Air Force One, despite both countries using Boeing 747s for presidential travel.
For a head of state, a presidential aircraft is more than a means...
title: How does Xi Jinping’s ‘special plane’ compare with Air Force One?

author: Nayan Seth,Ji Siqi
description:
Differences between Washington and Beijing over potential investment announcements have created roadblocks for a Chinese business delegation expected to accompany President Xi Jinping on his state visit to the US, according to sources.
The window for travel is narrowing by the hour for these Chinese business leaders, with Xi expected to arrive in Washington by Wednesday.
A source familiar with the discussions said Washington and Beijing had yet to resolve their disagreements over the Board of...
title: Fissures over US investments stall plans for Chinese business leaders to join Xi visit

author: Zhang Tong
description:
China has just taken a quiet but critical step in space-based electronic warfare.
A Lijian-1 Y18 rocket lifted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northern China at noon on Sunday, carrying nine satellites. Among them were three Diting-01 satellites, which successfully entered their planned orbit.
The trio is named after Diting, a beast from Chinese mythology that crouches beneath the desk of Ksitigarbha, the bodhisattva of the underworld, and can identify all things simply by...
title: China launches its first commercial radio-tracking satellites in electronic warfare leap

author: Paul Buck
description:
In June, Chinese regulators approved the world’s first CAR-T cell therapy for solid tumour cancers, developed by a drug company based in Shanghai. One month later, at a hospital in the city, a New Zealander with advanced cancer of the stomach and small intestine became the first international patient to receive the breakthrough treatment.
Chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy, to give it its full name, is a cutting-edge treatment that, until then, had only been approved to treat blood...
title: China’s cancer breakthrough on CAR-T cell therapy shows progress
